# AGT-MEM-02

**Is memory isolated per user or tenant, with stated retention?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | MEM: Memory and context |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.agent.memory.isolation`, `elements.agent.memory.retention` |

## Rule

Every agent with long_term_store has isolation other than shared, and retention.

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI06 Memory and Context Poisoning (`owasp-asi06`)
